testsuite.name: gspa.integration.promotion.PromotionStrategySpec

testcase.name: GreedyStrategy keeps best of competing suggestions for the same gap
GreedyStrategy respects at-most-one per protein across gaps
GreedyStrategy with maxPerIteration=1 degrades to strict best-first
MaxSatStrategy picks the highest-weighted non-conflicting set
empty candidates produce empty output regardless of strategy
BeamSearch picks top candidate per gap when no cross-gap conflicts
BeamSearch with width > 1 can beat greedy when top-1 blocks a better downstream
MaxSat coherence bonus prefers completing one pathway (3 commits → 3 pairs) over higher individual scores
BeamSearch degrades to single-path when width = 1
